K10 Identity and versions (US-270-12a, US-270-13b). Automatos Cloud has no version flow for community items: submit_item writes version '1.0.0' every time (marketplace.py:833) and a resubmission is a NEW marketplace row (cloned_from_id = the submitter's workspace agent, :827); a Playbook resubmission with the same name is refused until the old row is removed (workflow_recipes.py:1395-1403) and is then a new row too (cloned_from_id :1432); no route edits a marketplace row (the agent and Playbook update routes take workspace rows only, workflow_recipes.py:561). So an item is keyed by its LINEAGE and versioned by its CONTENT. externalId = the first 32 hex of sha256('automatos-cloud:<type>:<lineage>') where lineage is 'from:<cloned_from_id>' when the row has one, else 'row:<natural key>' (an agent's public_id, core.py:287; a Playbook's template_id, :1374; a package's or plugin's slug): opaque, stable across resubmissions, never an id a route takes. version = the newest approved row's version; revision = the sha256 of the bundle's canonical bytes (K8). Locally ONE Cloud row per (type, externalId), updated in place when the revision moves (a row per version would list every version as its own card: list_items has no version grouping, marketplace.py:181-206), its version column set to local_version(version, revision). Every clone copies the version (cascade_installer.py:163; workflow_recipes.py:1543; package_installer._clone_recipe_to_workspace copies it reflectively, :281-289), so a workspace copy records what it was cloned from, and an update is a copy whose version differs from its Cloud row's (K17). A plugin is versioned by its own version (its files live under plugins/<slug>/<version>/, marketplace_s3.py:56-57): a changed revision with the same plugin version is refused ('a plugin changed without a new version'). An edge said in the docs: a submitter who deletes the workspace agent they submitted from (cloned_from_id ON DELETE SET NULL, core.py:310) starts a new lineage, so the next resubmission arrives as a new item.
